summary: Iteration 38 — Quote feature (end-to-end) + SEO + referral guard regression. Both backend (10/10 pytest) and frontend (full UI flow: footer-quote-btn → /quote → tour modal → Get my quote → /quote/Q-XXXXXX → quote-book-btn → /pay/{booking_id}) pass. Admin panel lists quotes with auth, 401 without. Quote mode exit restores 'Continue to Payment'. Sitemap/robots correct. Referral conversion guard verified at unit level (zero-total + gift_card skip).
critical_code_review_comments: quotes.py line 104: asyncio.get_running_loop().run_in_executor(..., _notify, q) — the returned Future is not awaited and the loop reference is captured eagerly; works today but any send_email failure is only logged inside _notify. Consider asyncio.create_task(asyncio.to_thread(_notify, q)) for cleaner semantics.

server.py line 726-734: referral guard now filters total<=0 and payment_method=='gift_card' both at the single-booking check AND inside prior_paid count_documents — matches spec. Note: `total: {'$gt': 0}` assumes stored value is numeric; if any legacy booking stored string total, it won't match (benign — would under-count prior paids).

Frontend DateTimePicker: data-testid='booking-date-time-input' is attached to the TIME input only; the DATE field has no stable testid (uses button:has-text('Select date & time')). Adding data-testid='booking-date-input' to the date trigger would simplify automation.

rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Validated: (1) POST /api/quotes short-circuits before welcome-discount block via BookingCreate.quote_only; (2) GET quote returns public shape; (3) PDF endpoint returns application/pdf with %PDF header; (4) POST /quotes/{id}/book is atomic (status→booking claim) and idempotent (returns same booking_id on 2nd call); (5) expired quote → status=expired, book→400; (6) /api/admin/quotes requires auth (401 without, 200 with Bearer); (7) referral conversion skips zero-total and gift-card payments; prior_paid filter also excludes those; (8) SEO document.title + meta description update per route; sitemap includes /quote and /tours/cable-beach-day; robots.txt has 'Disallow: /quote/' followed by 'Allow: /quote'.
